name: Commercial Auto Fleet Schedule Builder
summary: Build the vehicle, driver, radius, and use schedule a commercial auto submission needs.

spec.user: A business with vehicles preparing a commercial auto submission or renewal.
inputData: Vehicle categories, weight classes, and counts
Driver count bands and MVR review practice
authoritativeSources: FMCSA published filing requirements where applicable
spec.privacyBoundary: No VINs, no driver names, no license numbers, no addresses.
decisionRules: Filing requirements are cited to the federal or state source.

This tool never states that a risk is eligible, ineligible, standard market, non-admitted, FAIR Plan eligible, bound, or uninsurable. It shows the published pathway criteria and names who actually decides, which is the insurer.
spec.uncertainty: Filing obligations depend on operation type and jurisdiction.
exportFormat: PDF via the browser print dialog
spec.updateCadence: Reviewed at least every 180 days, and immediately when a cited source changes.
